articles.title: ‘Blue Film,’ Controversial Cam Boy Drama, Acquired by Obscured Releasing: ‘A Lot of People Were Scared’ (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.summary: Obscured Releasing has acquired 'Blue Film,' a sexually charged drama about a fetish camboy and an anonymous client. The film received strong reviews despite its controversial subject matter. This acquisition represents a development in independent cinema distribution, indicating market interest in diverse and potentially boundary-pushing narratives within the entertainment sector.

articles.title: EU capitals say deleting US tech is not realistic
articles.summary: Estonia's Digital Minister Liisa-Ly Pakosta revealed that persistent cyberattacks from Russia have significantly enhanced the nation's digital resilience. These repeated incidents have inadvertently strengthened Estonia's cybersecurity infrastructure, making it highly prepared for diverse future challenges. This proactive adaptation against sustained external threats serves as a crucial lesson in national security and strategic preparedness.

articles.title: Fantasy Basketball Week 17 Start/Sit: Key players who have proven themselves as every-week starters
articles.summary: The news marks the conclusion of the trade deadline in fantasy basketball, transitioning focus to the upcoming All-Star break, which entails a week-long hiatus. This period will feature a shortened week of active play, requiring participants to strategically manage their teams and adapt to limited game days before the full break begins.

articles.title: This Artist Re-Creates Mindblowing Realistic USS Bowfin Submarine Environment in 3D
articles.summary: Evgeny Romanov, a freelance concept artist and former 3D hardsurface artist, specializes in creating atmospheric environments and character designs for the gaming and entertainment industries. His work involves leveraging advanced digital art techniques to build immersive visual experiences. This highlights the growing significance of digital creativity and technological artistry within modern entertainment sectors.

articles.title: Shaheed DySP Manjit Singh Memorial Volleyball Club Poonch clinches Winter Cup trophy
articles.summary: The Indian Army successfully concluded the Winter Cup Volleyball Championship in Surankote, Poonch, with immense enthusiasm and sportsmanship. This event highlights the Army's vital role in community engagement and fostering civil-military relations. Beyond combat duties, such initiatives promote sports among local youth and strengthen bonds with the population, showcasing the armed forces' commitment to national development and social harmony in border regions.

articles.title: Guhn Twei to release new album
articles.summary: A revealed tracklist for 'Une ville, une mine, un cancer' points to a powerful artistic exploration of critical socio-environmental issues. Song titles like 'Ville fantome' and 'Culture du silence' suggest themes of industrial pollution, health crises, and societal silence surrounding environmental degradation. This project likely offers a profound commentary on challenges faced by communities globally, encouraging deeper reflection.

articles.title: AVX Networks awarded last-mile grant for subsea fiber to Catalina Island
articles.summary: AVX Networks secured $37.5 million in federal funding from the California Public Utilities Commission's Last Mile Federal Funding Account. This grant, dated February 2026, is designated for deploying crucial broadband infrastructure in Orange County, California, enhancing connectivity and technological access for the region.
